text: {"lessons":["I should avoid making impulsive decisions based on a single month’s price move; selling Stock A at a loss did not by itself show that selling was the right choice.","I should set clear, long-term reasons and limits for each holding before trading, rather than letting gains or losses alone drive my decisions.","I should keep enough cash and diversify thoughtfully while investing regularly, since my apartment goal is years away and my account can fluctuate month to month."]}
